name: FiMba-1
intro: A physically modelled kalimba: the white keys are tines laid out like the real thing (lowest in the middle), the black keys roll the scale's chords; turn SELECT for the metal, ENV for the body, tap ARP for an mbira pattern.

rows.what: Tine page: Material, Hardness, Decay, Tone; again: Character.
Step through all eleven pages in turn.
Keys page: Layout, Scale, Key, Black; again: Play (Strum ms).
Octave down (OCT+ up), -2 to +2.
Save now; it also saves itself seconds after a change.
Pluck a tine; the lowest (dim-lit white key 9) sits mid.
Thumb-roll chord on scale degrees I to vii.
Seventh chords on I, IV, V and vi.
Scale: Major, Minor, Penta, ... Hirajoshi, Blues, Mbira, Chromatic.
Key C to B (Keyboard layout: transpose).
Palm mute: damp every ringing tine.
Layout: Tine, Keyboard (keys as printed), Mirror.
Black keys: Chords, Sharps (second row) or Perform.
Material: Steel, Brass, Bronze, Aluminium, Bamboo, Glass.
Hardness: soft thumb pad (0) to bright fingernail (100).
Character: Worn, Glide, Tuning (Equal / Just), Release (Ring / Damp).
Body page: Body, Buzz (mbira rattle), Wah, Wah rate.
Body: None, Board, Box, Gourd.
Cover the sound hole for the wah (Box, Gourd only).
Mbira pattern on / off over the last chord chosen.
Pattern running: a chord key gives it a new chord.
Pattern page (same as SEQ), without starting it.
Pattern: Thumbs, Cascade, 3 over 2, Interlock.
Pattern tempo 40-200 BPM; MIDI clock takes over.
Space: Reverb, Size, Delay, Time (ping-pong).
Color: Tape, Lo-fi, Chorus, Filter (low-pass left, high-pass right).
Grain: a granular cloud of what you play; KNOB 1 level.
Spread: Spray, Feedback (echo repeats), Width.
Freeze the grain cloud as a drone; again to go live.
Setup: Tune, MIDI ch, MIDI out, Theme; header shows version.
MIDI channel: Omni or 1-16.
MIDI out: send the keys as MIDI notes.
Theme: Light or Dark screen.
1.5 s: RESET? Then SAVE resets the sound to defaults.
Both for 5 seconds: update mode, for installing firmware.
Hardware calibration: teach each button and knob.
On the SAFE MODE screen: try starting again.

tips: Try it in the browser first: jadamsowers.github.io/fm1-fimba runs the same firmware code.
Keys don't sense velocity: Hardness sets how firm every pluck is (MIDI velocity does it over MIDI).
Wah needs a body with a sound hole: on None or Board its knobs show -- and NO HOLE.
Black keys in Perform: 1 mute, 2 cover the hole, 3 freeze, 4 / 5 octave down / up while held, 6-11 the six materials.
SELECT, ALGORITHM and PRESETS work on every page; the header shows key and scale.
A dot in the header means unsaved changes; the reset keeps the Setup page.
checked: v0.6.1 mirror (VERSION 0.6.1), firmware/src/app/plat.h: B_* enum by printed label (B_SEL = SEL), EN_SELECT/ALGO/PRESET/K1-K4; panel.c B_NAME labels.

ui.c VIEW_BTN / VIEW_KNOB: HOME Tine+Character, ENV Body, FX Space+Color, LFO Grain+Spread, SEL Keys+Play, SEQ Pattern, GLO Setup; button(): same button again = next page, EDIT = (view+1)%11, PLAY freeze, REC km_damp_all, ARP pattern toggle, OCT -/+ P_OCTAVE, SAVE project_save.

ui.c input(): ARP held 500 ms -> V_PATTERN without toggle; SAVE held 1500 ms -> reset_ask, SAVE again resets (Setup params kept), other button/key or 5 s keeps; SELECT material, ALGORITHM scale, PRESETS key (Tine) / transpose (Keyboard).

ui.c black_down: Chords = km_chord_cents roll with Strum delay, pattern on -> pool_set; Sharps = left white key +100 cents; Perform mute/hole/freeze/oct-/oct+/materials. WHITE_K/BLACK_K index tables; center_key WHITE_K[8] = white key 9 (Tine).
ui.c turn/knob_off: Wah and Wah rate need km_body_hole (Box, Gourd) else 'NO HOLE'. autosave after 4000 ms quiet, not while frozen.

kalimba.c PARAMS: names, ranges, defaults (Body Box, Pattern Thumbs, Tempo 40-200 96, MIDI ch 0 = Omni, Theme Light); PAT names Thumbs/Cascade/3 over 2/Interlock; BODY None/Board/Box/Gourd; 12 scales.
kalimba.c km_chord_cents: CH_DEG per black key, k < 7 triad (+ root octave up), k >= 7 four-note seventh; matches README (I-vii, then 7ths on I IV V vi).

main_fm1.c: OCT- + OCT+ held 5 s -> enter_uboot (countdown from 2 s); both held at power-on -> panel_setup (HARDWARE CALIBRATION); safe_main after two failed boots, PLAY = try again; four failed -> chip update mode. No OCT--alone rescue in this firmware.
ui.c midi_in: clock F8/FA/FB/FC drives the pattern; notes with pattern on build its chord.
unsure: Scale names in code are abbreviated on screen (Mixolyd., Harm. m, Alumin.); sheet uses the README's full names.
In Keyboard layout all 27 keys play their printed note and black keys are not chords; the key zones show the default Tine layout only.
MIDI CC map (1 wah, 64 sustain, 72/73/74 decay/hardness/tone, 91/93/94 reverb/grains/delay, PC = material) verified in ui.c midi_cc but left out; no MIDI & sync section.
Not tried on hardware or in the browser emulator.
